name: upasswords-monorepo
description: UPasswords root workspace: shared web-extension code + per-browser packaging

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @upasswords/extension-shared build && pnpm --filter @upasswords/extension-safari build && pnpm --filter @upasswords/extension-chrome build && pnpm --filter @upasswords/extension-edge build && pnpm --filter @upasswords/extension-firefox build
scripts.clean: rm -rf WebExtensions/shared/dist WebExtensions/safari/src/shared WebExtensions/chrome/src/shared WebExtensions/edge/src/shared WebExtensions/firefox/src/shared
